title: Safety Finding
description: Audit finding record for Safety OS evidence trail

legal_basis.description: Applicable law articles — minimum 3 regulatory sources

agent_id.description: Optional (v2.1): agent attribution. Legacy records were authored in audit sessions with no dispatching agent; their audit_trail.created_by holds a git-history author, not an agent id (zero-fabrication rule).

workflow_id.description: Optional (v2.1): workflow execution reference. Findings originate from audit sessions, not dispatched workflows — never invent an ID to satisfy this field.

audit_trail.description: ALCOA+ audit trail — created_at/created_by/record_status enforce the AGENTS.md timestamp-in-every-record rule for findings. Legacy (pre-v3) records carry a backfilled trail derived from git history — see evidence-models/migrations/README.md.
